protocol: Unmodified native finite shots; no subdivision, noise, background or fitting.
units: Concentrations M; native volumes uL and enthalpies cal/mol; native dQ microcalories converted to J.

acceptance.rule: User-selected practical limit: 0.01% of peak injection heat.
acceptance.diagnostic_goal: abs(actual-expected) <= 512*epsilon*(peak_abs_heat + abs(expected)); theoretical goal, not a release requirement
